title: 101 Dalmatians.
lines: In the city of London lives a dog.
That's a white dog with black spots.
Pongo lives with Roger, a musician.
Roger plays the piano and writes songs.
Pongo thinks Roger needs a wife.
And he thinks he needs a wife himself too.
One day Pongo looks out of the window.
A pretty lady is walking by with a dog.
A Dalmatian, with a white coat and black spots.
And the lady's name is Anita.
He pulls Roger along to the park.
He runs around the bench where Anita is sitting.
He wraps the leads around Roger and Anita.
They both fall into the pond.
They look at each other, soaking wet.
Roger and Anita fall in love.
And Pongo and Perdita get married too.
They all live together in a little house.
On a stormy evening Perdita has puppies.
There's Lucky, who always watches TV.
And Patch, with a spot around his eye.
But then someone comes to visit.
Her name is Cruella De Vil.
Her hair is half black and half white.
She wears a big fur coat.
She drives a big red car, much too fast.
And she wants a coat made of Dalmatian fur.
The puppies are not for sale.
A few weeks later Roger and Anita go for a walk with Pongo and Perdita.
Then two crooks come into the house.
Their names are Horace and Jasper.
They put all the puppies in a sack and take them away.
How will they find their puppies?
When it gets dark, he barks from a hill in the park.
A dog further away hears it.
And that dog barks it on again.
That's how the message goes from dog to dog, across the whole country.
Far away, on a farm, an old dog hears it.
Tibs creeps up to a big old castle.
They walk through the snow, through the cold.
They walk for days and nights.
At last they reach the castle.
Horace and Jasper are watching TV.
The puppies run outside, through a hole in the wall.
He lets the puppies roll in the soot from a chimney.
They don't look like Dalmatians anymore, but like black Labradors!
They walk past Cruella, and she doesn't notice.
They jump into a big lorry.
But snow falls from a branch.
She drives after the lorry in her red car.
She skids off the road and crashes into Horace and Jasper's car.
Their cars fall into the snow.
Roger and Anita are so happy when they see Pongo and Perdita.
What shall we do with all these puppies?
He sits down at the piano.
We'll buy a big house in the countryside, he says.
And so they all live together.
With lots of barking and lots of spots.
